sentences.en: There is a dense growth of vines in this forest.
sentences.zh: 在这片森林里藤蔓生长得非常茂盛。

sentences.en: Yanni says he can weave baskets with these woody vines.
sentences.zh: 亚尼说他可以用这些木质的藤编织篮子。

sentences.en: A mystery disease caused the grapes to wither on the vine.
sentences.zh: 一种神秘的疾病导致葡萄在植株上枯萎了。

senses.zh: 藤；葡萄树；藤本植物；攀缘植物
